e37242242feb156d17119578.prompt:
Turn this dispatcher's message into a routing problem.

Message: "Driver's at the depot. Needs to get to the Riverside job. Old bridge is shut this morning, resurfacing, so route around it."

Known locations: ['depot', 'industrial', 'market-st', 'north-gate', 'old-bridge', 'ring-road', 'riverside', 'south-quay']

Return JSON only:
{"start": "<location>", "goal": "<location>", "blocked": ["<location>", ...]}

blocked lists locations that cannot be routed through, for closures or restrictions.
Use the location names exactly as written above. If nothing is blocked, use [].

59f6757193aef086eabf288d.prompt:
Turn this account manager's note into constraints for a fulfilment plan.

Note:
"Spoke to their ops director. They'll accept a partial shipment as
long as the balance lands before month end, which gives us twelve days total. What they
won't take is the substitute part -- it failed qualification at their site last year and
their quality team won't sign it off again. They're also the reference account for the
tender we're in next quarter, so this is not one to be late on."

Available sourcing options: ['air_freight', 'partner_stock', 'port_bonded', 'pull_production', 'regional_wh', 'substitute_sku']

Return JSON only:
{"days_available": <number>,
  "excluded": ["<option>", ...],
  "partial_shipment_acceptable": true or false}

excluded lists options the customer or the situation rules out. Use the option names
exactly as listed. Return [] if nothing is excluded.
